title: I made Gaffer XI, a football draft game and it just launched on iPhone (and Android)
author: Matsss
selftext:
Hey all! I’m a solo dev from the Netherlands and I’ve spent the last months building **Gaffer XI**, a football draft game. It went live on the App Store this week, and on Android Play Store last week!

**How it works:** every pick comes from a real squad from a real season. You get one squad at a time, take one player from it, and build your dream XI that way. Then you take that team into a cup, a full league season or a World Tournament and watch every match play out live.

**What’s in it:**

* 1,000+ squads from the ’50s to today, across the big European leagues, Brazil and the World Cups
* Live matches with commentary, or sim straight to the result
* Sticker packs and an album to complete, with rare Rainbow cards
* Weekly events, a daily challenge and duels against friends
* A Hall of Fame to climb, per league and per era

It’s **free to play and you don’t need an account**. There are ads, and an optional one-time Plus purchase if you want to support it.

🍎 iPhone: [https://apps.apple.com/app/id6815814591](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6815814591)  
🤖 Android: [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.gafferxi.mobile](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.gafferxi.mobile)

I’d love to hear what you think, especially what feels too easy or too hard. I read every comment and I’m still updating it every week.

Hey u/Matsss, this falls under Rule 4. Sharing your game is okay here, free or paid, but you need to talk about how it was developed using AI, so the community has something to discuss. This post doesn't have enough on that yet.

To keep it up, edit your post or reply to this comment within an hour with some details on your dev process, like:

- which AI tools you used, and what for
- how they fit into your workflow
- problems you hit and how you dealt with them

"Made with AI", a list of tools or a ChatGPT bullet list won't cut it. If nothing's added by then, this post may be removed.

If you think we got this wrong, [message the mods](https://www.reddit.com/message/compose?to=/r/aigamedev).
